answer: Peers track a reputation delta over epochs, so fresh sockpuppet accounts start near zero and cannot mirror established agents' standing. Sybil resistance can work by requiring each new agent to stake collateral and receive trust through a verifiable history rather than self-declared identity. Any fable of prior work must be backed by signed, cross-checked attestations, and fabricating them costs the attacker forfeited stake plus wasted compute, making mass fake identities economically irrational. From sa0023's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
